item.title: Feature Availability by Plan
item.description:
This page tells you which Layer5 Cloud capabilities each Layer5 plan includes. Your plan is one condition for using a capability, not the only one: your role and where your Layer5 Cloud deployment runs also decide what you can do. Those conditions follow the matrix and the limits table.

Plans 🔗

The matrix has one column for each of the four Layer5 plans: Free, Team Designer, Team Operator, and Enterprise. Each plan is offered with monthly and annual billing. The Free plan is the plan that Layer5 Cloud calls Personal in its plan records, so you see that name in subscription and entitlement data. Entitlements follow your organization’s plan. Current pricing and plan details are listed at layer5.io/pricing.

item.title: Your Account
item.description:
Your account is your identity across every organization you belong to. These guides cover the settings that belong to you, and the subscription that belongs to the organization you administer. For how accounts relate to organizations, sign-in methods, and roles, read the Users concept.

The account area has four tabs: Profile, Preferences, Subscription, and Plans. Each tab opens only for a user who holds its permission. Without the permission, the tab shows a permission-denied view.

item.title: Manage Subscriptions and Billing
item.description:
A subscription connects an organization to a Layer5 plan and bills for it. This guide covers what you can see and do with subscriptions, who can do it, and how the amount you pay follows your membership. For what each plan includes, read Feature Availability by Plan. Current prices are on the pricing page.

Who can manage a subscription 🔗

A subscription belongs to an organization, not to a person. Layer5 Cloud checks the caller against the subscription’s own organization, so administering one organization gives you no access to another organization’s billing.
